```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

This script computes the split-half reliabilities of the ARF, CALF and RT control tasks. It saves:

1. The reliability of each task and modality, overall (partialing out grade), by grade bin and for the adults (Table 1; Table S9.1).
2. The reliability of each RT control block for the whole sample (reported in the text).
3. The reliability by ALPACA math ability quintile (Table S7.1; Table S9.2).
4. The score mean (SD) and range by ALPACA math ability quintile (Table S7.2; Table S9.3).
5. The reliability of the residual scores, after controlling for simple response-entering speed, overall, by grade bin and by ALPACA quintile (Table S7.3; Table S9.4).

# Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(splithalfr) # spearman_brown
```

# Paths and settings

```{r}
# "cleaned" for the fully cleaned scores, "no_cleaning" for the uncleaned scores
version <- "cleaned"

scores_dir <- here("data", "scores")

# Each version: its input files, where its results go, and the output file names 
versions <- list(
  cleaned     = list(scores_file = "scores_combined_rt-3-75_5-875-7917_math.csv",       
                     all_apps_file = "scores_all_apps_rt-3-75_5-875-7917_math.csv",    
                     results_dir = here("results"),
                     adults_file = "table1_adults_reliability.csv",                   
                     files = c(rel_grade_bin = "table1_reliability_grade_bin.csv",
                               rel_rtControl = "reliability_rtControl.csv",
                               rel_ability = "sup7_table1_reliability_alpaca_ability.csv",
                               descriptives_ability = "sup7_table2_descriptives_alpaca_ability.csv",
                               rel_residual = "sup7_table3_residual_reliability.csv")),
  no_cleaning = list(scores_file = "scores_combined_no_cleaning.csv",
                     all_apps_file = "scores_all_apps_no_cleaning.csv",
                     results_dir = here("results", "no_cleaning"),
                     adults_file = "sup9_table1_adults_reliability.csv",
                     files = c(rel_grade_bin = "sup9_table1_reliability_grade_bin.csv",
                               rel_rtControl = "reliability_rtControl.csv",
                               rel_ability = "sup9_table2_reliability_alpaca_ability.csv",
                               descriptives_ability = "sup9_table3_descriptives_alpaca_ability.csv",
                               rel_residual = "sup9_table4_residual_reliability.csv"))
)

scores_file <- versions[[version]]$scores_file
all_apps_file <- versions[[version]]$all_apps_file
results_dir <- versions[[version]]$results_dir
adults_file <- versions[[version]]$adults_file
output_files <- versions[[version]]$files
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

sub_data <- read.csv(file.path(scores_dir, scores_file))
scores_all <- read.csv(file.path(scores_dir, all_apps_file))
```

# Table 1: Split-half reliability by grade bin and for adults

```{r}
grade_bins_df <- sub_data %>%
  dplyr::select(ID,
                arf_prod, arf_2afc, calf_prod, calf_6afc,
                even_arf_prod, odd_arf_prod,
                even_arf_2afc, odd_arf_2afc,
                even_calf_prod, odd_calf_prod,
                even_calf_6afc, odd_calf_6afc,
                user_grade_at_run) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(arf_prod, arf_2afc, calf_prod, calf_6afc,
             even_arf_prod, odd_arf_prod,
             even_arf_2afc, odd_arf_2afc,
             even_calf_prod, odd_calf_prod,
             even_calf_6afc, odd_calf_6afc),
    names_to = c("prefix", "condition"),
    names_pattern = "^(even|odd)?_?(arf_prod|arf_2afc|calf_prod|calf_6afc)$",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prefix = case_when(
    prefix == "" ~ "score",
    prefix %in% c("even", "odd") ~ paste0(prefix, "_score")
  )) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = prefix,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  mutate(grade_as_int = as.integer(case_when(user_grade_at_run == "Kindergarten" ~ "0",
                                             .default = user_grade_at_run))) %>%
  mutate(bin_char = case_when(grade_as_int %in% c(0,1) ~ "K-1",
                              grade_as_int %in% c(2,3,4) ~ "2-4",
                              grade_as_int %in% c(5,6) ~ "5-6",
                              grade_as_int %in% c(7,8) ~ "7-8",
                              grade_as_int %in% c(9,10,11,12) ~ "9-12")) %>%
  mutate(bin_char = factor(bin_char, levels = c("K-1","2-4","5-6","7-8","9-12"))) %>%
  drop_na()
   
# Overall reliability
overall_rel_df <- map_dfr(c("arf_prod", "arf_2afc", "calf_prod", "calf_6afc"), function(task) {
  even <- sub_data[[paste0("grade_resid_even_", task)]]
  odd <- sub_data[[paste0("grade_resid_odd_", task)]]
  keep <- !is.na(even) & !is.na(odd)
  tibble(condition = task, count = sum(keep), reliability = spearman_brown(even[keep], odd[keep]))
}) %>%
  mutate(bin_char="All")

# By grade bin
grade_lm_df<-grade_bins_df %>% 
  group_by(condition,bin_char) %>%
  summarise(count=n(),
            reliability=spearman_brown(even_score,odd_score),
            .groups="drop") %>% 
  mutate(bin_char=as.character(bin_char))

to_save_rel_ability <- bind_rows(overall_rel_df, grade_lm_df) %>%
  mutate(rel = paste0(sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.2f", reliability)), " (", count, ")"),
         condition = factor(condition, levels = c("arf_prod", "arf_2afc", "calf_prod", "calf_6afc")),
         bin_char = factor(bin_char, levels = c("All", "K-1", "2-4", "5-6", "7-8", "9-12"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(grades = bin_char, condition, rel) %>%
  arrange(condition) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = rel) %>%
  arrange(grades) %>%
  rename(arf_fr = arf_prod, arf_fc = arf_2afc, calf_fr = calf_prod, calf_fc = calf_6afc) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(as.character(.), ""))) %>%
  bind_rows(read.csv(file.path(results_dir, adults_file), colClasses = "character"))

to_save_rel_ability

write.csv(to_save_rel_ability,file.path(results_dir, output_files["rel_grade_bin"]),row.names = FALSE)
```

# RT control reliability

```{r}
rt_blocks <- c(fr = "production", "2afc" = "2afc", "6afc" = "6afc")

rtControl_rel <- imap_dfr(rt_blocks, function(block, block_name) {
  halves <- sub_data[complete.cases(sub_data[, paste0(c("rtControl_first_", "rtControl_second_"), block)]), ]
  reliability <- spearman_brown(halves[[paste0("rtControl_first_", block)]], halves[[paste0("rtControl_second_", block)]])
  tibble(condition = block_name, rel = paste0(sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.2f", reliability)), " (", nrow(halves), ")"))
}) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = rel)

rtControl_rel

write.csv(rtControl_rel, file.path(results_dir, output_files["rel_rtControl"]), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Supplement 7

## Table S7.1: Split-half reliability by math ability

```{r}
ability_bins_df<-scores_all %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID,alpaca_score,even_arf_prod,odd_arf_prod,even_arf_2afc,odd_arf_2afc,even_calf_prod,odd_calf_prod,even_calf_6afc,odd_calf_6afc,user_grade_at_run) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(even_arf_prod, odd_arf_prod,
             even_arf_2afc, odd_arf_2afc,
             even_calf_prod, odd_calf_prod,
             even_calf_6afc, odd_calf_6afc),
    names_to = c("prefix", "condition"),
    names_pattern = "(even|odd)?_?(.*)",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prefix = ifelse(prefix == "", "score", paste0(prefix, "_score"))) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = prefix,
    values_from = value
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    bin = cut(
      alpaca_score,
      breaks = quantile(alpaca_score, probs = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1), na.rm = TRUE),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels =1:5
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(bin_char = case_when(bin == 1 ~ "1 [0-20%]",
                              bin == 2 ~ "2 (20-40%]",
                              bin == 3 ~ "3 (40-60%]",
                              bin == 4 ~ "4 (60-80%]",
                              bin == 5 ~ "5 (80-100%]")) %>% 
  mutate(bin_char = factor(bin_char, levels = c("1 [0-20%]", "2 (20-40%]", "3 (40-60%]", "4 (60-80%]", "5 (80-100%]"))) %>% 
  drop_na()

to_save_rel_ability<-ability_bins_df %>% 
  group_by(condition,bin_char) %>%
  summarise(count=n(),
            reliability=spearman_brown(even_score,odd_score),
            .groups="drop") %>% 
  mutate(rel_n=paste0(sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.2f", reliability)), " (", count, ")")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(condition,rel_n,bin_char) %>% 
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("arf_prod", "arf_2afc", "calf_prod", "calf_6afc"))) %>% 
  arrange(condition,bin_char) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = rel_n) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(., "")))

to_save_rel_ability

write.csv(to_save_rel_ability,file.path(results_dir, output_files["rel_ability"]),row.names = FALSE)
```

## Table S7.2: Descriptive statistics by math ability

```{r}
task_labels<-c(arf_prod = "arf_fr", arf_2afc = "arf_fc", calf_prod = "calf_fr", calf_6afc = "calf_fc")

sd_range_ability<-ability_bins_df %>%
  left_join(scores_all %>%
              dplyr::select(ID, arf_prod, arf_2afc, calf_prod, calf_6afc) %>%
              pivot_longer(-ID, names_to = "condition", values_to = "score"),
            by = c("ID", "condition")) %>%
  group_by(condition, bin_char) %>%
  summarise(mean_sd = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), sd(score, na.rm = TRUE)),
            range = paste0("[", round(min(score, na.rm = TRUE), 2), ", ", round(max(score, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "]"),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(task_labels[condition], levels = task_labels)) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(mean_sd, range), names_to = "stat", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(stat = factor(stat, levels = c("mean_sd", "range"))) %>%
  arrange(condition, stat, bin_char) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(condition, stat), values_from = value, names_sep = "_")

sd_range_ability

write.csv(sd_range_ability,file.path(results_dir, output_files["descriptives_ability"]),row.names = FALSE)
```



## Table S7.3: Split-half reliability after controlling for simple response-entering speed

```{r}
residual_rel<-function(data, group_col){
  data %>% 
    group_by(condition, group = .data[[group_col]]) %>% 
    summarise(count=n(),
              reliability=spearman_brown(resid_score_even_score,resid_score_odd_score),
              .groups="drop") %>% 
    mutate(group=as.character(group))
}

# Overall and by grade bin
grade_resid_df<-sub_data %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID,arf_prod,arf_2afc,calf_prod,calf_6afc,resid_score_even_arf_prod,resid_score_odd_arf_prod,resid_score_even_arf_2afc,resid_score_odd_arf_2afc,resid_score_even_calf_prod,resid_score_odd_calf_prod,resid_score_even_calf_6afc,resid_score_odd_calf_6afc,user_grade_at_run) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(arf_prod, arf_2afc, calf_prod, calf_6afc,
             resid_score_even_arf_prod,resid_score_odd_arf_prod,resid_score_even_arf_2afc,resid_score_odd_arf_2afc,resid_score_even_calf_prod,resid_score_odd_calf_prod,resid_score_even_calf_6afc,resid_score_odd_calf_6afc),
    names_to = c("prefix", "condition"),
    names_pattern = "(resid_score_even|resid_score_odd)?_?(.*)",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prefix = ifelse(prefix == "", "score", paste0(prefix, "_score"))) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = prefix, values_from = value) %>% 
  mutate(grade_as_int=as.integer(case_when(user_grade_at_run == "Kindergarten" ~ "0",
                                           .default = user_grade_at_run))) %>% 
  mutate(bin_char = case_when(grade_as_int %in% c(0,1) ~ "K-1",
                              grade_as_int %in% c(2,3,4) ~ "2-4",
                              grade_as_int %in% c(5,6) ~ "5-6",
                              grade_as_int %in% c(7,8) ~ "7-8",
                              grade_as_int %in% c(9,10,11,12) ~ "9-12"),
         all = "All") %>% 
  drop_na()

# Alpaca ability quintile
ability_resid_df<-scores_all %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID,alpaca_score,resid_score_even_arf_prod,resid_score_odd_arf_prod,resid_score_even_arf_2afc,resid_score_odd_arf_2afc,resid_score_even_calf_prod,resid_score_odd_calf_prod,resid_score_even_calf_6afc,resid_score_odd_calf_6afc,user_grade_at_run) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(resid_score_even_arf_prod,resid_score_odd_arf_prod,resid_score_even_arf_2afc,resid_score_odd_arf_2afc,resid_score_even_calf_prod,resid_score_odd_calf_prod,resid_score_even_calf_6afc,resid_score_odd_calf_6afc),
    names_to = c("prefix", "condition"),
    names_pattern = "(resid_score_even|resid_score_odd)?_?(.*)",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prefix = ifelse(prefix == "", "score", paste0(prefix, "_score"))) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = prefix, values_from = value) %>% 
  mutate(bin = cut(alpaca_score,
                   breaks = quantile(alpaca_score, probs = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1), na.rm = TRUE),
                   include.lowest = TRUE,
                   labels = c("1 [0-20%]", "2 (20-40%]", "3 (40-60%]", "4 (60-80%]", "5 (80-100%]"))) %>% 
  drop_na()

row_order<-c("All", "Grades", "K-1", "2-4", "5-6", "7-8", "9-12",
             "Ability Percentile Range", "1 [0-20%]", "2 (20-40%]", "3 (40-60%]", "4 (60-80%]", "5 (80-100%]")

tableS7_3<-bind_rows(residual_rel(grade_resid_df, "all"),
                     residual_rel(grade_resid_df, "bin_char"),
                     residual_rel(ability_resid_df, "bin")) %>% 
  mutate(rel = paste0(sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.2f", reliability)), " (", count, ")"),
         condition = factor(condition, levels = c("arf_prod", "arf_2afc", "calf_prod", "calf_6afc"),
                            labels = c("arf_fr", "arf_fc", "calf_fr", "calf_fc"))) %>% 
  arrange(condition) %>% 
  dplyr::select(group, condition, rel) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = rel) %>% 
  bind_rows(tibble(group = c("Grades", "Ability Percentile Range"))) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = row_order)) %>% 
  arrange(group) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(as.character(.), "")))

tableS7_3

write.csv(tableS7_3,file.path(results_dir, output_files["rel_residual"]),row.names = FALSE)
```
